packs.title: Lines across Town
packs.promise: Read low rooflines, small street symbols and a landscape shaped by travel.

q.s: Find three small details that make room for a day.
st: Choose an open path or comfortable bench away from vendors and events.
Find a surface that guides movement, a feature that offers rest and an edge that protects planting.
Record one small design choice that makes each feature useful.

q.s: Find three meetings between a soft outline and a firm edge.
st: Stay on the public sidewalk outside the museum entrance.
Find a rounded wall or roof edge, a straight wooden detail and a recess.
Compare how each catches light, then draw three marks that suggest those differences.

q.s: Collect three different ways the ground is arranged.
st: Use an open public path outside planted beds and children’s play areas.
Find a planted strip, an open ground area and a path edge.
Record how those three spaces invite different kinds of movement or rest.

packs.title: Canyon Road Close Up
packs.promise: Find a gallery street’s small materials, side-lane changes and lived history.

q.s: Collect the small contrasts around a gallery street.
st: Choose a comfortable public stopping point clear of the intersection and gallery entrances.
Find an earth-toned wall, a wooden detail and a metal or stone edge.
Describe the contrast among the three materials and choose the one that changes most in the light.

q.s: Find the small features that make an entrance legible.
st: Choose a public-sidewalk or street-side stopping point clear of the shop entrance and traffic.
Find a doorway, a window or display opening, and a detail that distinguishes the front from its surroundings.
Describe the smallest feature that helps you recognize where to arrive.

q.s: Collect a line for the road, the roof and the sky.
st: Stay clear of the intersection and choose a comfortable public viewpoint.
Find one line that follows the road, one that belongs to a roof or wall, and one open gap toward the sky.
Describe how those three directions keep the view from feeling flat.
